role: Protocol-agnostic high-performance file transfer with structured output.

capabilities.name: head
capabilities.description: Show the first bytes of a remote or local file.

capabilities.name: schema
capabilities.description: Emit the JSON-LD ontology for agent discovery.

capabilities.name: capabilities
capabilities.description: Report which protocols and features this build supports.

capabilities.name: checksum
capabilities.description: Hash a file. Reads it in full.

capabilities.name: get
capabilities.description: Fetch a remote file to a local path.

capabilities.name: put
capabilities.description: Upload a local file to a remote path.

capabilities.name: move
capabilities.description: Move a file. The source does not survive.

capabilities.name: sync
capabilities.description: Reconcile a directory tree against another. Scope is the tree, not one file.

capabilities.name: serve
capabilities.description: Serve files over the network until stopped.

capabilities.name: plugin
capabilities.description: Load or unload a plugin -- executable code entering the process.

capabilities.name: telemetry
capabilities.description: Inspect or change telemetry opt-in state.

note: Neither field is derived. This tool enumerates its commands but declares no effect, safety or authority data, so requires_grant and budgeted are judgements made from command semantics and are labelled as such rather than presented as the tool's own position. Replace this file with a derived one if the tool ever declares effects, the way abt, Rodeo, Botnet, MAGE and HyperMachine do. The rule applied: a grant is required to write, delete, move, serve, load code, or touch keys or telemetry state. remove and move are granted because the source does not survive either; head, list, schema, capabilities and checksum only read. plugin is granted because loading a plugin puts executable code into the process, which is a larger authority than any file operation here. Budgets follow bytes moved or time served, so checksum is budgeted while ungranted -- it reads a whole file without needing permission to.
